name: spawn
js: (async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,4000));let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<3000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});console.log('[bench] spawn '+((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(2)+' ms')})()
